label: Lichen and Mould
blurb: Grows lichen or mould over the shot as if the picture were a damp old surface. Colonies start one after another and spread outwards: crustose lichen with a pale lobed margin that cracks into little plates and raises dark fruiting discs as it ages, bright orange wall lichen, white fluffy mould that turns powdery green-blue from the middle in growth rings, or black damp mould with a stain spreading ahead of it. Darker parts of the picture count as damper and grow faster. Key Growth, or set Grows in over to watch it spread.
